description: Telangana CM Revanth Reddy introduced AI education in schools and AI-based courses, guaranteeing immediate industry placement for graduates. The state also launched 100 new public schools, a government breakfast scheme, and private school fee regulation.
body_lead: Telangana CM Revanth Reddy to Introduce AI Education in Schools and Polytechnics, Breakfast Scheme Introduced Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy recently announced the introduction of AI education in schools and AI-based courses in polytechnics and ATCs. Graduates of these courses will receive immediate industry placement. The state also launched 100 new public schools, a government school breakfast scheme, and measures to regulate private school fees. Key Points - Telangana CM Revanth Reddy announced the introduction of AI education in schools.
